reaction 1
Br₂(aq) + 2NaOH(aq) →NaBr(aq) + NaOBr(aq) + H₂O(l)

reaction 2
3NaOBr(aq) →2NaBr(aq) + NaBrO₃(aq)

both reaction 1 and reaction 2

options.C: O decreases by 1 and H increases by 1.
